g.title: VEH
g.text: +12 V CONSTANT (5 A fuse at source)
Battery, master switch and fuse box upstream (see wiring overview)

g.title: W_FEED
g.text: VEH:1:+12 V CONSTANT (5 A fuse at source)
18-14 AWG fine on a 5 A fuse. IGN is a sense line (any gauge).

g.title: DCDC_IN
g.text: Mini-Fit Jr, 6-34 V, 10 A fuse on board
Automotive mode. Timing preset OFFDELAY 1 min + HARDOFF 1 min. Mini-USB port = config only, not power. Vaux unused.

g.title: DCDC_OUT
g.text: Mini-Fit Jr, V(out) jumpered to 5 V
Default is 12 V. Set 5 V, MEASURE before the Pi. ~33 W, mount with airflow. Need ≥5.0 V at Pi.

g.title: W_PI5V
g.text: USB-C pigtail, rated 5 A. Short and heavy (≤30 cm).

g.title: W_HDR
g.text: HAT stacked on the GPIO header (logic power + SPI)

g.title: DCDC_PSW
g.text: Pulses after OFFDELAY; power cut HARDOFF later

g.title: W_PSW
g.text: Soft-shutdown pulse. Verify which PSW pin is the switched side.

g.title: HAT
g.text: 2x MCP2518FD on SPI0 CE0/CE1, isolated bus side
can0 IRQ GPIO25, can1 IRQ GPIO24 (verify). ch0 120R OFF, ch1 120R ON. No 12 V into the HAT.

g.title: W_CAN0
g.text: Twisted pair + CAN ground. Short stub off the Haltech bus.

g.title: W_CAN1
g.text: Twisted pair + ground, ~1-1.5 m, 120 ohm each end

g.title: ECU
g.text: Bus already has 2 terminators. Do not add a third (measure ~60 ohm).

g.title: EPAS
g.text: 120 ohm at this end unless the ECU has one (measure). Motor feed + IG wake wired separately.
